wallBattlement.structureContract: Two separate full-height square battlement segments attach along the outside edge of a standard wall. Each logical footprint is exactly 64x64, so two adjacent battlements span exactly one 128-unit wall edge with no body gap or overlap and each occupies one quarter of a 128x128 wall cell by area. Every base, body, groove, datum band, crown band and cap uses the same exact 64x64 horizontal cross-section; the high and low variants differ only along Z, preventing the low cap or decorative relief from protruding into its neighbor. Gameplay cover height remains 220/196 above the ground, while the authored visual body is 350.72/315.04 units tall so the accepted 65px half-slot width can display at approximately 238/217px with one uniform scale instead of stretching the texture vertically. A dark separation course marks the standard 160-unit wall datum without changing the footprint. The main wall remains the continuous walkable rampart behind them; each outer-edge battlement top is solid, blocked and non-walkable. Geometry, fixed pixels-per-world camera, canonical crop and scale remain identical across all five material tiers. The rune tier keeps the high and low body textures clean; one deterministic decal from a four-glyph pool is centered between the two slots only when a complete pair exists on the same support wall and edge.
